prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / style-transfer.
Asset type: high-fidelity Simplified Chinese desktop app design proposal.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the existing PeerGlide / 屏跃 device hub UI. Keep the device-first composition, two device cards, hierarchy, navigation items, screen-position preview, action flow, small unavailable-feature tiles, and all Chinese text legible.
The user REJECTED the blue-white color direction. Redesign the entire color/material system into a sophisticated WARM SAGE + FOREST GREEN + restrained LIME palette.
Palette: background warm sage-gray #E9ECE5; panels warm ivory #F5F5EF; sidebar rich forest #18392F; primary text deep green-black #172F28; secondary text #6C796D; subtle borders #D4DCD1; primary CTA muted fresh lime #C2DF83 with dark forest text; selected sidebar item a quiet lighter green well with pale lime line icon; forest-green links, no bright blue anywhere. Deep forest + warm ivory balance, daylight usability, low-saturation calm surfaces, beautiful restrained tactile depth, 12px radii, elegant spacing. Only one lime primary CTA. Status icons remain distinguishable from the accent, always paired with words.
Recolor the original linked-double-screen brand icon: deep forest squircle with pale lime screen glyph; preserve its recognizable geometric double-screen shape. Recolor all illustrations to neutral forest/sage with a hint of warm lime, including the screen-position blocks. No cobalt/cyan, no blue wallpaper, no blue Windows logo; use neutral generic laptop and desktop illustrations.
Make this feel like a refined independent desktop productivity app, comfortable to use all day. Do not make a glossy gaming UI, admin dashboard, flat monochrome wireframe or busy editorial poster. No neon glow, no pink, no glassmorphism, no giant gradients or paper texture.
Text hierarchy preserved: brand 屏跃 / PeerGlide. Sidebar 总览, 设备与屏幕 selected, 本机鼠标 with 预览, 剪贴板与文件 with 开发中, bottom 设置.
Title 设备与屏幕, subtitle 一套键鼠，自在穿梭。, top-right 恢复本机 and ＋ 添加电脑.
Tabs 设备 selected and 屏幕布局.
Cards: 这台 Mac / 本机 / 系统权限已就绪 / 重新检查; Windows 工作电脑 / 已连接 / 键鼠尚未开启 / 接收许可由对方设置.
Action strip 两台电脑已连接, 开启键鼠前，需要双方分别确认。, primary 开启键鼠协同…, secondary 断开连接.
Section 屏幕位置, link 调整布局 →, labels 本机 / 工作电脑, caption 相对位置示意.
Bottom 本机鼠标 · 窗口内预览 and 剪贴板与文件 · 尚未接通.
Outside app frame a quiet caption 屏跃 · 视觉提案 02 and 设备与状态为设计示例.
Complete straight-on landscape desktop window around 16:10, no perspective. All statuses are visual examples, not live session claims. No account, subscription, remote video, terminal, invented latency or extra devices.

Use case: ui-mockup precise-object-edit. Input image is the current PeerGlide forest/sage/lime design proposal and the edit target. Make ONE correction only: top-right “＋ 添加电脑” must be a quiet OUTLINED secondary button, warm ivory fill matching the nearby 恢复本机 button, dark forest text/icon and a thin forest-gray border. Remove its lime fill. The ONLY solid lime call-to-action in this connected-state screen must remain “开启键鼠协同…”. Preserve the entire remaining image exactly: forest sidebar, warm sage/ivory palette, original double-screen green icon, layout, device illustrations, all Chinese lettering, status text, screen preview, caption 视觉提案02. Do not move or add anything; no blue.
